_note: Protocol traces for CI (cctv100, 2 Nov 2026). STRUCTURE and field names follow the public vendor documents below; VALUES (serials, IPs, times, boxes) are synthetic. None of these were captured from a real camera yet - the owner's real-device run (owner_actions/CCTV_GAP_TO_100_BN.md section 4) replaces/adds captured traces.
hik_linedetection_acusense_ver20.xml: Hikvision ISAPI Developer Guide (Event / HTTP Listening, EventNotificationAlert ver20 schema); AcuSense detectionTarget + TargetRect (0..1 floats, newer firmware)
hik_videoloss_heartbeat_ver10.xml: Hikvision ISAPI: the periodic videoloss/inactive heartbeat older ver10 firmware posts to the alarm host
hik_shelteralarm_ver20.xml: Hikvision ISAPI eventType shelteralarm = Video Tampering
hik_fielddetection_rect1000_ver20.xml: Hikvision ISAPI intrusion (fielddetection) with TargetRect in 0..1000 ints (older smart-event firmware)
dahua_attach_videomotion.mime: Dahua HTTP API v2.x eventManager.cgi?action=attach stream (multipart/x-mixed-replace; boundary=myboundary, text/plain Code=...;action=...;index=...)
dahua_attach_crossline_data.txt: Dahua HTTP API v2.x attach with the IVS data={...} JSON block (Object.ObjectType, BoundingBox in the 0..8191 coordinate system); layout as printed in public integration logs (e.g. the open-source Home Assistant 'dahua' integration issues)
imou_callback_human.json: Imou Open Platform message callback (setMessageCallback, msgType human, did/cid/time/alarmId/picurlArray) as used by the open-source imou_life Home Assistant integration
imou_callback_aiper.json: Imou newer AI PTZ firmware: person alarm reported as msgType e_multiVideoAiPerArea
imou_callback_status_online.json: Imou callback status message (online) - not an alarm
imou_callback_foreign_pic.json: Imou alarm whose picture sits on a host outside our SSRF allow-list (hypothetical object-storage host) - must be refused and reported, not downloaded
ezviz_alarm_device_list.json: EZVIZ Open Platform POST /api/lapp/alarm/device/list response (page/data/code/msg; alarmId, alarmType, alarmTime ms, channelNo, isEncrypt, alarmPicUrl, deviceSerial)
